_comment: Storage proxy mount table. Copy to config.mounts.json (gitignored) and set ENABLE_STORAGE_PROXY=1. Each mount serves an S3 bucket as read-only byte passthrough from a backend, ALONGSIDE the relational->Iceberg path. Backends: 'local' (a filesystem path, incl. an OS-mounted NFS/SMB share) and 's3' (a native upstream S3/MinIO/S3-compatible bucket). For 's3', 'root' is the upstream bucket; secrets live in the encrypted credential store keyed by 'credential' (never inline) — a credential-less mount must set an explicit 'auth' mode ('anonymous' or 'instance'). The bucket must differ from the DB warehouse bucket (S3_BUCKET).
